description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for three different models—Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni—on a benchmark task. The horizontal axis displays the model names in the order Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, and is labeled “Model”. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents accuracy values on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals.  There are two bars for each model, with the first bar in a lighter blue color representing “MMAU” and the second in a darker purple color representing “MMAR”, as indicated in the legend. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 48 and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 32. For Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 62 and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 38. For Qwen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 68 and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 52. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each model, with MMAU consistently appearing to the left of MMAR within each group. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
